title: cluster-issuer chart values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on issuer config drift. cert-manager rejects an issuer with missing ACME fields silently (issuer enters Failed state, certs never issued). Schema catches at helmfile lint.

issuerKind.description: Issuer kind: selfsigned (local dev) | acme (Let's Encrypt prod/drill). No other values supported.

email.description: ACME account email — MUST match basic email pattern (anything@anything.anything, no spaces). Let's Encrypt sends expiry warnings here. Note: schema uses pattern (always enforced) instead of format:email (only enforced when consumer passes FormatChecker — not the case in helm/helmfile lint).

server.description: ACME server URL. Prod = letsencrypt.org/directory (5 cert/week rate limit). Staging = acme-staging (no rate limit, untrusted CA). Other URLs rejected to prevent accidental third-party ACME provider. Note: format:uri removed (silently permissive in default jsonschema) — enum is the load-bearing constraint here, format is redundant.

privateKeySecretRef.description: Secret name holding ACME account private key. Empty = cert-manager auto-generates (acceptable for dev; not for prod where key continuity matters).

loopzeroCaIssuerName.description: Name of the always-created LoopZero CA issuer for local fallback (loopzero-ca-issuer). Used by services that lack ACME-reachable DNS.

selfSignedAliases.description: Names of extra self-signed ClusterIssuers. For environments that cannot complete an ACME challenge and still name the production issuer.
